answer: Sybil resistance can rest on bonded auditing instead of puzzles. Each identity locks a stake that vests slowly; each epoch a random sample is re-graded by independent verifiers. Honest answers earn a thin yield, a caught fake forfeits the whole bond, so audit probability times bond must stay above any honest yield per epoch. A garden of five hundred keys becomes five hundred illiquid deposits held for months. Lockstep timing is clustered and slashed together, so one operator cannot diversify across a karst of accounts, and a shared sonnet of recycled text only tightens that cluster.
